company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
sector: Steel processing centre (coated steel for appliances)
brlm: Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Private Limited
reference_note: Upper band Rs 82 (NSE issue page). At Rs 82: market cap Rs 515.2 cr post-issue; P/E 18.0x FY25 EPS post-issue (11.6x pre-issue, 13.9x pro forma for interest saved); P/B 1.81x; EV/EBITDA 8.0x. Oct-2025 private placement was at Rs 88.

flags: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -71.7% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause
model.reverse_dcf: Current free cash flow is negative, so no multiple can be stated: the price assumes cash generation improves from here.

call_basis: Call rule (ROUTINE.md hard rule 6), judged at the Rs 82 upper band: Neutral fair value Rs 116 is 41.0% above the price, so the Subscribe limb applies. Provisional: company figures are from the DRHP (to Sep-2025) because the RHP was not retrievable. No material issue was found.
headline: A four-plant steel processor feeding India's AC and refrigerator makers (revenue Rs 1,056 cr, up 34% a year FY23-25), raising Rs 183 cr of fresh money mainly to repay debt, priced at 18x FY25 earnings after the issue (14x pro forma for lower interest), below the Rs 88 paid by investors in Oct-2025; fair value Rs 116 (Neutral) against Rs 82.
red_flags: Revenue Rs 590.88 cr -> Rs 1,055.71 cr FY23-25 (33.7% CAGR); H1 FY26 Rs 491.51 cr, below the FY25 run-rate; adjusted EBITDA margin 6.4% -> 7.0% (H1 FY26 7.8%) (pp. 122, 279)
Debt/equity 3.33x (FY25), 2.88x (Sep-25); finance cost 42% of EBITDA; Rs 125 cr of the issue repays debt (pp. 108, 123, 279)
JSW Steel Coated Products 90.61% of coil supply; appliances 81.80% of product revenue; top-10 customers 67.44% (pp. 30-31, 37)
Promoters hold 97.78% at an average cost of Rs 1.25-12.50; Oct-2025 placement at Rs 88, above the Rs 78-82 band (pp. 27, 35, 94)
25 delayed RoC filings and a 2021 allotment-filing error under adjudication; board independent directors appointed Mar-2025 (pp. 44-46, 248)
Fair value Rs 108 / 116 / 126 at Rs 82 (Bear / Neutral / Bull); reported P/E a fair measure (adjustments -4.0%); provisional: figures to Sep-2025 from the DRHP

strengths: Plants inside appliance clusters in the West, North and South (p. 208)
Authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products (p. 208)
Revenue up from Rs 590.88 cr to Rs 1,055.71 cr in two years (p. 279)
Adjusted EBITDA margin 7.84% in H1 FY26 (p. 122)
opportunities: Appliance manufacturing growth under the PLI scheme (pp. 143, 178-187)
Lower interest after Rs 125 cr debt repayment (p. 108)
threats: Customers buying from mill service centres (part 2)
